messages:
ellie: Heads-up: I saw duplicate deliveries from sampleapp when a client got 429 during token rotation. Two POSTs ~1.1s apart.

ellie: Repro: local sampleapp + short token TTL + high concurrency /generate loop. Node SDK v0.11.4, streaming enabled.

ravi: Can you paste the receiver logs + request ids?

ellie: logs:
2026-03-22T14:02:10Z req=rw_a1 got body len=712
2026-03-22T14:02:11.137Z req=rw_a2 got body len=712

ben: Looks like client retried too eagerly after the 429 during rotation. No Idempotency-Key present in the requests.

mina: Short-term: add randomized backoff (jitter) for 429 retries and attach Idempotency-Key for webhook posts. Also tweak sampleapp to avoid early ack until webhook dispatcher confirms final delivery in streaming mode.

ravi: Long-term: SDK parity doc needs a replay-guard spec (Node/Go/Py). We'll require an opt-in safeReplay flag for now, plus telemetry.

ellie: I'll open a draft PR to sampleapp to add Idempotency-Key + opt-in safeReplay. Also adding e2e test that simulates token expiry mid-request.

ci-bot: CI queued for redwood/sampleapp#459 (branch: safe-replay)

ben: Ops mitigation: lowered token rotation frequency in demo cluster and added alert for duplicate deliveries >0 within 30s.

mina: I'll draft a short RFC for headers (Idempotency-Key, X-Original-Request) and TTLs for server-side dedupe.

ravi: Thanks. Action items: ellie PR + e2e test, mina RFC, ben monitoring. Revisit parity checklist after RFC. :thumbsup:
